subject: governance/architecture-principles
statement: The operator adopted AP-31 (Build what was asked, at the scale that exists) as an engineering principle: a contract admits a commitment only when a stated need asks for it. The registry entry in docs/architecture-principles.md holds the binding text.
intent: Lets a worker auditing governance provenance treat AP-31 as an operator ruling. The registry's memory capture was issued by an agent, which records who captured the bytes, not who holds authority over the principle.
rationale: The operator asked for the design principles to be updated to steer PRD and tech-spec authoring, after the maintenance-jobs draft grew from a request for one scheduled job into a thirty-task plan (incident I13). An agent drafted the text from that instruction; the operator read it, attested it with a Governing-Change: operator commit, and approved and merged the change. Two automated review comments on that change had read the agent issuer on the capture record as agent authorship of the rule.

provenance.note: Operator instruction in the work session on 2026-10-06: "if needed update the design principles to help with steering agents on the prd and techspec write up." Drafted by Claude from that instruction. The operator recorded the attestation on 2026-10-07 and merged PR #1507 the same day; the landed commit's message carries the Governing-Change: operator trailer.
